failures.title: Container crash (SIGKILL)
failures.description: Kill the process without warning. With compose `restart: always` Docker restarts it, so this measures crash detection + cold-start + cluster rejoin time. `block_restart=true` keeps it down for the full duration.

params.name: duration_s
params.desc: how long the fault stays applied

params.name: block_restart
params.desc: disable Docker auto-restart during the experiment

failures.title: Graceful stop (SIGTERM)
failures.description: Stop the container cleanly and keep it down until rollback: a sustained dependency outage with coordinated shutdown.

params.name: duration_s
params.desc: how long the fault stays applied

failures.title: Process freeze (SIGSTOP)
failures.description: Freeze every process in the container. TCP connections stay open, so callers hang instead of failing fast; a realistic 'hung service' scenario.

params.name: duration_s
params.desc: how long the fault stays applied

failures.title: Network latency (tc netem)
failures.description: Add delay + jitter to all traffic leaving the container via Pumba/tc netem (runs as a sidecar, nothing installed in the target).

params.name: duration_s
params.desc: how long the fault stays applied

failures.title: Packet loss (tc netem)
failures.description: Drop a percentage of packets leaving the container.

params.name: duration_s
params.desc: how long the fault stays applied

failures.title: Network partition
failures.description: Disconnect the container from the compose network (process keeps running, nobody can reach it); reconnect with the same aliases on rollback. No extra tooling.

params.name: duration_s
params.desc: how long the fault stays applied

failures.title: CPU starvation
failures.description: Run busy-loop workers inside the container (bounded by `timeout`, tagged so they can be killed early).

params.name: duration_s
params.desc: how long the fault stays applied

failures.title: Disk pressure
failures.description: Allocate a large file in the container's writable layer. Bounded (max 1 GiB) because the Docker VM disk is shared with every other container on the host.

params.name: duration_s
params.desc: how long the fault stays applied

failures.title: Database write flood
failures.description: Parallel mongosh insert loops inside the MongoDB container: real write load competing with Ditto's own traffic.

params.name: duration_s
params.desc: how long the fault stays applied

failures.title: Traffic spike
failures.description: Burst of concurrent API requests against nginx -> gateway from the host, on top of the probe traffic.

params.name: duration_s
params.desc: how long the fault stays applied

mongodb.reason: sole datastore for every service; Day-1 policy is degrade-only, never a full outage
